High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. Identity (chosen details override the automatic look)

Armor: rigid hard-surface mecha armor — solid plates of enamelled metal and ceramic with visible thickness, bevelled edges, layered rims, panel lines, seams, small vents, sensor lights and mechanical joints, casting real shadows onto the undersuit. The plates sit on top of her body as separate machined parts, never printed or painted onto fabric, never a patterned bodysuit.
Silhouette: ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Solid hard-surface plates that read as armor, not cloth.
Colours: gray, cream, blue.
Wear: the heavy, gray shell becomes a dome-backed mantle over her shoulders and upper back, its rim framing both shoulders; the short horn becomes a horned circlet or hair ornament; the tightly curled ears become a headpiece or hair ornament of the same shape; its markings (darker blue spots) become painted lines and patterns on her plates and undersuit.

Camera level with her face; her body and face turned gently three-quarters toward the camera (never a back view), her head level with her chin neither raised nor tucked, no upward perspective on her face.
Pose: Default stance is a standing, card-ready pose; motion, effects and setting may be dramatic while her design stays readable.
Type effects: One open hand conjuring a cyan-blue water glow amid floating water droplets, bubbles and thin water rings. A pale blue icy glow pulses along her armor seams and joints. Floating water droplets, bubbles and thin water rings circle slowly around her.

One figure only.
